name: @morra/web
description: The real morra micatio game app (M4): Vite + React + TS, consuming @morra/{core,recognition,platform-web}. Game/session state lives OUTSIDE React (a plain store, ported from spikes/s03-beat.html's self-paced sync-mode round flow) — React only subscribes via useSyncExternalStore and renders low-frequency projections. spikes/** stays untouched; it is the parity oracle for this app.
